item.title: Large tree, overhanging branches, 11th August
item.description:
A tree which was just a sapling when I moved in back in 2013 is now a large tree with overhanging branches. Birds defecate all over my car costing me a fortune to clean. Also tree pollen covers my car constantly. I cannot park anywhere else as my daughter is autistic and I have to park on that drive! It's driving me mad. Either cut the thing down or trim the branches. The branches are also affecting telephone wires
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 189, Sherwood Park Avenue, Blendon, Sidcup, Greater London
